opportunities.title: The $114M Bug Was in the Random Numbers: What Coldcard's Firmware Fix Actually Admits
opportunities.why_now: Coldcard just shipped a firmware patch after a $114-130M theft traced to weak seed generation, and even used AI to find more bugs.
opportunities.angle: Technical postmortem/explainer: break down what 'weak seed generation' means in practice, why hardware wallets aren't a silver bullet, and what self-custody users should verify right now on their own devices.

opportunities.title: They Have Your Number: Inside the Phishing Campaign Targeting 885,000 Crypto Users by SMS
opportunities.why_now: A cybersecurity firm just unveiled a phishing operation with a target list of 885,000 phone numbers tied to crypto holders.
opportunities.angle: Threat breakdown + reader self-check: how the list was likely compiled (exchange leaks, KYC data), what the messages look like, and a checklist to know if you're on it.

opportunities.title: MANTRA Just Hit the Off Switch — And Proved Your 'Decentralized' Chain Has One
opportunities.why_now: MANTRA froze all transactions and halted its network following an incident, reigniting the centralization-vs-decentralization debate mid-crisis.
opportunities.angle: Sharp opinion piece: catalog every chain that's frozen/halted after an exploit (Solana, BSC precedents) and argue that 'freeze capability' is now a quiet industry standard nobody disclosed upfront.

opportunities.title: BounceBit's Answer to a $3M Hack: Abandon the Chain Entirely
opportunities.why_now: BounceBit is sunsetting its own blockchain and migrating to BNB Chain in direct response to a $3M exploit.
opportunities.angle: Case study on 'exploit-and-exit' as a security failure mode: what breaks when a project decides forking to a bigger chain is easier than fixing its own, and what it means for users' assets during migration.

opportunities.title: AI Crime Is Up 40% and Everyone's Busy Watching Bitcoin Hit $80K
opportunities.why_now: TRM Labs reports AI adoption in crypto crime rose 40% over the past year, landing the same week as a euphoric market rally that's pulling attention away from security news.
opportunities.angle: Contrarian market-vs-security tension piece: while headlines chase the rally, quietly compile what AI-enabled scams/exploits actually look like now (deepfake KYC, automated phishing, AI-assisted contract exploits) and why bull markets are peak harvesting season for attackers.
